units: <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on II Samuel 13:6">Targ. II Sam. XIII, 6</cite>.

senses.gloss: (cmp. next wds. a. צמת) to cause contraction by scalding or by putting in vinegar. Part. pass. חָלִיט.
units: <cite ref="Chullin 111a:3">Ḥull. 111ᵃ</cite> <he>ח׳ הוי מעיקרא</he> Rashi (ed. <he>מִיּחֲלַט הוה ח׳ ליה וכ׳</he>) it (the liver) was first scalded (so as to emit no blood in boiling).

senses.gloss: to cause contraction, to scald, put in vinegar. Ib. חַלְּטֵי ליה וכ׳.
units: <cite ref="Pesachim 74b:13">Pes. 74ᵇ</cite> bot. <he>חלא דח׳ ביה וכ׳</he> vinegar which one has used once for drawing the blood from meat and contracting the blood vessels, must not be used a second time.
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Proverbs 20:19">Targ. Prov. XX, 19</cite>; <cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Proverbs 24:21">XXIV, 21</cite> (h. text <he>תתערב</he>).
